simple.meaning: חֹרֹנִי (Chôrônîy) is a Hebrew word meaning “a Choronite or inhabitant of Choronaim.” BibleIQ connects the English word back to this source word so its use can be compared across Scripture.
simple.biblicalBackground: חֹרֹנִי (H2772) appears 3 times in the Hebrew Bible, beginning at Nehemiah 2:10, with occurrences in Nehemiah.

simple.summary: חֹרֹנִי (Chôrônîy) / H2772 is traced through Nehemiah 2:10, Nehemiah 2:19, Nehemiah 13:28 using source-language evidence and occurrence comparison.

definitions.short: a Choronite or inhabitant of Choronaim
definitions.full: H2772. Choroni חֹרֹנִי adjective, of a people see id.

occurrences.englishText: When Sanballat the Horonite, and Tobiah the servant, the Ammonite, heard of it, it grieved them exceedingly, because a man had come to seek the welfare of the children of Israel.

But when Sanballat the Horonite, Tobiah the Ammonite servant, and Geshem the Arabian, heard it, they ridiculed us, and despised us, and said, “What is this thing that you are doing? Will you rebel against the king?”
One of the sons of Joiada, the son of Eliashib the high priest, was son-in-law to Sanballat the Horonite; therefore I chased him from me.
